authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL kardama gives Oriya kādua/kādo, Gujarati kādav, Maithili kādau/kadwā and Hindi kādau/kādo, alongside nasalized Old Awadhi kāṁdau and Hindi kā̃daw/kā̃do from *kaddaṽa. These support the selected short kādev/kaduə/kaḍeu and nasal variants with vowel and dental/retroflex notation retained. Extra -ḍu suffix forms are excluded; local IA transmission and the article’s reported paṅka influence remain unresolved. Exact response: keṇḍəu.
